Please note that our team is unable to bring the cash to the apartment so in this case.

The refund can only be made via bank transfer if you are unable to visit our office to collect the cash.

Once the bank transfer has been completed, we will share the transfer receipt with you for your reference.

Kindly also note that if you do not check out on time, a late check-out fee will be applied.
Thank you for your understanding.
